map.由净利润、折旧摊销与营运资本变动求 OCF 使用指南: Deriving OCF from Net Profit, Depreciation and Amortization, and the Change in Working Capital User Guide
map.经营现金流(OCF)计算器，输入净利润、折旧摊销与营运资本变动，按 OCF=净利: Operating Cash Flow (OCF) Calculator: enter net profit, depreciation and amortization and the change in working capital to get cash inflow from the main business as OCF = net profit + depreciation - change in working capital.
map.OCF = 净利润 + 折旧摊销 − 营运资本变动: OCF = net profit + depreciation and amortization - change in working capital
map.输入净利润、折旧摊销与营运资本增加额，求经营现金流。: Enter net profit, depreciation and amortization and the increase in working capital to find operating cash flow.
map.填写「折旧摊销 (万元)」。: Enter the depreciation and amortization (10k CNY).
map.填写「营运资本增加 (万元)」。: Enter the increase in working capital (10k CNY).
map.用间接法将净利润还原为经营活动的真实现金流入。: Uses the indirect method to restore net profit into the real cash inflow from operating activities.
map.评估企业主业的自我造血能力，判断能否靠经营覆盖投资与偿债。: Assess a business's self-generated cash ability to judge whether operations can cover investment and debt repayment.
map.监控应计利润与现金流背离，预警盈利质量下滑。: Monitor the divergence between accrual profit and cash flow to warn of declining earnings quality.
map.间接法计算经营现金流: Operating Cash Flow by the Indirect Method
map.：某公司净利润 200 万元，加回折旧摊销 80 万元，营运资本增加（应收、存货: A company has net profit of 2 million CNY, adds back 800k of depreciation and amortization, and an increase in working capital (receivables and inventory up, payables down) ties up 500k, so operating cash flow = 200 + 80 - 50 = 2.3 million CNY.
map.为什么要加回折旧摊销？: Why add back depreciation and amortization?
map.折旧摊销是非付现费用，已减少净利润但未流出现金，间接法需加回以还原为现金口径。: Depreciation and amortization are non-cash expenses that reduced net profit without a cash outflow, so the indirect method adds them back to restore a cash basis.
map.营运资本增加为什么减现金？: Why does an increase in working capital reduce cash?
map.应收、存货增加或应付减少意味着现金被占用（先垫资后回款），故作为减项；反之释放现: An increase in receivables or inventory, or a decrease in payables, means cash is tied up (you fund first and collect later), so it is a deduction; releasing cash is added back.
